sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the move] US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent 'recently moved out of his home and onto a military base after Iranian threats against his life,' the New York Times reported Tuesday, citing three people familiar with the matter. A Treasury spokesperson told the NYT Bessent 'will not be deterred by the Iranian regime's threats.' [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- the plots] Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached 'advanced stages,' a senior Trump administration intelligence official warned in a memo seen by Reuters late last month. Fox News Digital, via a senior administration official, put it stronger: threats reached 'more than an advanced stage' (CGTN carry, published 10:10+08:00 = 06:10 ). [VERIFIED FACT -- the context] Bessent has led Washington's economic pressure campaign against Tehran since August; the US-Israeli war on Iran began Feb 28. [VERIFIED FACT -- the limits] The NYT itself reported the severity of the threats against Bessent 'was not immediately clear,' and that US officials believe Iran's ability to carry out large-scale attacks in the US and overseas is limited. Iran has previously denied plotting attacks against US officials and individuals on American soil. [CONTEXT -- same threat picture] On Monday the US evacuated 10 refuelling aircraft from RAF Mildenhall (England) after an Iran threat deemed credible and raised FPCON to Charlie at Mildenhall and Lakenheath (WSJ/CNN, recorded in Nov 10 scans).
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct tiered publisher families: New York Times (T2) as origin; Reuters (T1) as relay carrying the NYT report plus its own memo reporting. The Hindu (T2), Straits Times (T3), Times Now, JBizNews, Astro Awani are relays of the same NYT/Reuters reporting and add no independent evidence. Fox News Digital (via CGTN carry) has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Iran has previously denied plotting to attack officials and people on US soil. The NYT itself says the severity of the threats to Bessent was not immediately clear, and US officials assess Iran's ability to carry out large-scale attacks in the US as limited. No Iranian statement, indictment or public evidence ties a specific plot to Bessent. The 'more than an advanced stage' upgrade comes from a single unnamed senior administration official via Fox News Digital (untiered).
sections.why_matters: The man running America's economic war on Iran just had to move onto a military base -- because Tehran is now hunting the sanctions chief himself. Same threat picture as the RAF Mildenhall evacuation on Monday.

totw_analysis: Our read: The man running America's economic war on Iran just had to move onto a military base -- because Tehran is now hunting the sanctions chief himself. Same threat picture as the RAF Mildenhall evacuation on Monday. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Real Iranian assassination plot reaching 'advanced stages' -- or threat-inflation by an administration that needs the economic war to look existential?
